blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Nest retains issuer / admin authority over vault shares with permissioned issuance and freeze surfaces beyond reserve-only exposure.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: nOPAL has four reviewed independent native-issuance routes on Ethereum, Plume, BSC, and Plasma; the Plume, BSC, and Plasma rows retain Ethereum as the issuer's primary reference but are canonical native issuance, not peripheral bridge representations. Nest's current registry and nOPAL integration guide identify a Solana LayerZero OFT route via OFT store FmeHf1FQJhXUWHVfLACCHJ8KvAJ7jpiDvukz8ZHP7XLq, authored below alongside two further LayerZero OFT representations established by fresh on-chain reads on 2026-09-05: the World Chain NestShareOFT proxy and the Avalanche deployment whose implementation bytecode is byte-identical to the verified World Chain NestShareOFT implementation apart from the per-chain LayerZero endpoint constant. The Plasma native deployment is live per the issuer registry but dormant, with zero supply at the reviewed block. LayerZero peer wiring and upgrade controls on the OFT representations were not verified.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-7 (lead pyusd-paypal); FIX2-09 Mint/Bridge boundary migration 2026-08-16; U5 Nest rail closeout 2026-09-05

routes.reviewNote: Independent native nOPAL issuance on Ethereum, not a bridge representation. At Ethereum block 25770421 on 2026-08-16, totalSupply() was 19,094,202.277440; owner() is the Nest Timelock 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a. The current 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 owns the Teller and Manager and is the Timelock proposer/canceller; no public bridge route was identified.

Independent native nOPAL issuance on Plume, not a bridge representation. At Plume block 87678480 on 2026-08-16, totalSupply() was 12,981,544.220067; owner() is the Nest Timelock 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a, and current owner()/vault() reads verify the same Teller 0xa5f8e5843dd597a179453bf782844e8bf808a90b and Manager 0xea452b14fc86847182f8dd0486206eb56dda0393. The current 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 is the Timelock proposer/canceller. Ethereum remains the issuer's primary reference only; this route is canonical native issuance.

Independent native nOPAL issuance on BSC, not a bridge representation. At BSC block 116347230 on 2026-08-16, totalSupply() was 13,997,699.499774; owner() is the Nest Timelock 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a, and current owner()/vault() reads verify the same Teller 0xa5f8e5843dd597a179453bf782844e8bf808a90b and Manager 0xea452b14fc86847182f8dd0486206eb56dda0393. The current 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 is the Timelock proposer/canceller. Ethereum remains the issuer's primary reference only; this route is canonical native issuance.
Nest's nOPAL integration guide says Solana mint flows route to Plume and deliver nOPAL through LayerZero OFT; its current registry identifies OFT store FmeHf1FQJhXUWHVfLACCHJ8KvAJ7jpiDvukz8ZHP7XLq.

Independent native nOPAL issuance on Plasma, not a bridge representation. At Plasma block 31652535 on 2026-09-05, name() was 'Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault', symbol() nOPAL, decimals() 6, totalSupply() 0, and owner() is the Nest Timelock 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a, the same owner as the Ethereum, Plume, and BSC deployments. The contract is a direct non-proxy deployment whose runtime bytecode is byte-for-byte the Ethereum nOPAL share contract except chain-specific immutables around the chain-id constant, and it contains no LayerZero endpoint, lzReceive, or peer surfaces. The deployment is live per Nest's registry (plasma startBlock 4904024) but dormant, with zero supply at the reviewed block.

The EIP-1967 implementation slot resolves to 0x03ff1b3d6c973b9de3f7916b8585a4065c53bb34, unverified on Snowscan; its runtime bytecode is byte-identical to the verified World Chain NestShareOFT implementation except the per-chain LayerZero EndpointV2 immutable (Avalanche endpoint 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c appearing eight times) plus one trailing metadata constant, and it carries the lzReceive dispatch and the peers-mapping slot.
